newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt paper trading session slated for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt paper trading session slated for Wed.

text.p: Russia's Central Bank will hold a trading session in series 24011, 24012, 24013, 24014, 24015 and 24016 OFZ interest-bearing bonds on Wednesday, a bank official said on Monday.
Trading sessions do not usually take place on Wednesdays, when auctions are normally held.

But the central bank, which has recently started repaying paper early in an effort to replace tax-exempt paper with taxed issues, has also started holding extra trading sessions to soak up the free money.
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry will repay series 24006 OFZ bond early. Trading will be held from 1200 GMT to 1230 GMT.
Banks cannot trade between themselves, and are only only allowed to buy paper from the Finance Ministry at the average prices from the previous day.
